name: How long does custom trim installation typically take for a residential project?

mainEntity.name: How long does custom trim installation typically take for a residential project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of custom trim installation varies based on the project's scope, complexity, and the size of your home. A small project, such as adding crown molding to a single room, might take 1-3 days. A more extensive project involving multiple rooms, intricate designs, or custom millwork could take 1-2 weeks or longer. Factors like preparation, material availability, and the type of finish (e.g., painting or staining on-site) also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies greatly depending on project size and complexity, from a few days for a single room to several weeks for a whole home.
